title: myrcia polyantha
intro: Myrcia polyantha, commonly known as the Brazilian pepper tree or guava tree, is a species of flowering plant in the family Myrtaceae. It has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including fever, digestive problems, and respiratory infections, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antibacterial properties. The therapeutic actions of Myrcia polyantha include its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and act as an expectorant, helping to relieve respiratory congestion. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
